items.article: Eating about two slices of deli meat daily was associated with substantially higher dementia and Alzheimer's risk, according to a new review of ultra-processed foods. New York-based registered dietitian Kelly Springer shares research on highly processed foods and explains how combining fruits, vegetables, nuts and other nutrient-rich options can support long-term health. Eating just two slices of deli meat a day was associated with a substantially higher risk of dementia, according to a new review of ultra-processed foods (UPFs) and brain health. The findings, published in the August 2026 issue of Annual Review of Nutrition, looked at dozens of human and animal studies, including one involving nearly 500,000 people in the U.K. The study found that each additional 25 grams of processed meat eaten daily corresponded with a 44% higher risk of all-cause dementia and a 52% higher risk of Alzheimer's. Twenty-five grams of processed meat equals roughly one to two slices of deli meat, depending on how thick the meat is sliced. items.article: In a bid to consolidate Muslim vote base in neighbouring west UP, SP replaces Shubham Giri with Abdul Mateen Siddiqui at the helm of Uttarakhand unit, calls Giri's performance “not satisfactory”. Less than five months before the high-stakes Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, Samajwadi Party (SP) chief Akhilesh Yadav has appointed a Muslim leader, Abdul Mateen Siddiqui, as the new president of the party unit in neighbouring Uttarakhand, replacing a mahant, Shubham Giri, who was named its working president over eight months ago. Uttarakhand is also slated for the Assembly elections along with UP, among other states, in February 2027. Siddiqui, 66, who hails from Nainital district, has held various positions in the Uttarakhand SP, including as its general secretary and state in-charge. He had also contested the Assembly election from Haldwani in 2007 and 2012 on the party ticket, but lost both times. This is the first time that the SP has appointed a Muslim face as the Uttarakhand unit president. Apart from forming a new Uttarakhand SP executive committee, Siddiqui has been asked to focus on nearly 20 Muslim seats of the state across Haridwar, Udham Singh Nagar, Dehradun and Nainital districts, where the Muslim community plays a key role in determining the poll outcome, party sources said. items.article: If your work email on your Mac isn't syncing today, it might well have to do with Microsoft's cut-off of Exchange Web Services (EWS). As of October 1, 2026, Microsoft began switching off EWS by default in Exchange Online. If you haven't heard of it before, EWS is the aging protocol that Apple's Mail and Calendar apps still use to sync Microsoft 365 work accounts. The cutoff has been signposted for a while. Microsoft stopped adding new features to EWS back in 2018, while in 2023 the company announced that it would start disabling the protocol in Exchange Online from October 2026. It's being described as a phased rollout, so some users may be impacted sooner than others. For those affected, system admins can still turn EWS back on, but only until April 1, 2027, when it shuts down for good. Apple says that it is "actively working with Microsoft" to move its Mac apps over to the newer Graph API in a macOS 27 update. That update has yet to arrive, but it surely won't be long before it does. In the meantime, Outlook for Mac works just fine, and iPhone and iPad users won't be affected because they use Exchange ActiveSync rather than EWS. Get weekly top MacRumors stories in your inbox.

Last week, homicide investigators shifted their focus from examining an archive of a million photographs and film recovered from what is known locally as the “house of horrors” to excavating what is in or under the home of Raymond “RC” Horsch, a career criminal, local artist, author and snuff photographer who died last year aged 82, and his son Eugene, 44. Amazon is addressing the Kindle ’s biggest problem – though not entirely. The company has launched a host of new Kindle e-readers, re-designing them to make them smaller and lighter. It has updated its base Kindle with a new design, as well as new versions of its easier-to-read Kindle Paperwhite and a new Kindle Colorsoft that has a colour display. But perhaps the biggest change comes with a host of new accessories that return a long-mourned experience back to Amazon’s e-readers. Users can finally actually click to turn pages. The launch of the new models also comes with the Kindle Click, a bluetooth remote that lets people turn their page from afar, and works with all Kindles going back to 2024 . items.key: ai:look inside: luxury kinsale penthouse with sea views for €3.25m
items.text: Look inside: Luxury Kinsale penthouse with sea views for €3.25m
items.article: Airy and spacious three-bed built on the site of a former Mercy Convent in popular west Cork location Imagine waking up in a penthouse and walking to the balcony outside your bedroom. Below you is the sea and in the distance, bobbing sail boats. A new luxury penthouse, built on the site of a former Mercy Convent in Kinsale , Co Cork , could afford you this experience. One of four apartments called Schooner Cove, the last of 30 to be built in a complex called Avila, the penthouse takes up the entire top floor of the former convent and offers incredible views. Developed by Cumnor Construction, the project is a far cry from the former Convent of Mercy and school, which formerly occupied the site. It opened in 1845 with 700 pupils and six Mercy Sisters at the start of the Irish famine. The convent and industrial school closed decades ago, and the school, convent, chapel and gardens were later sold. The three-bedroom penthouse, which spans 297sq m (3,200sq ft), was designed by JCA Architects. Airy and spacious, with high ceilings and elegant original columns, its rooms are differentiated by smoked-glass panel doors. Its large open-plan kitchen/dining/sittingroom opens to a terrace with sea views. The furnishings rely mostly on muted tones of grey, taupe, beige and blue, which combine well with its minimalist design and futuristic-style light fittings. One of the most striking aspects of this apartment is the large original sash ecclesiastical windows in the sittingroom space.
